id./param/scenario/cs/c_060_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"Oh... What a dazzling radiance.
  This is the Yata Mirror's true form...
  With this, surely...

"Mirror... with your pure light,
  sever the chains of the firedrake's fate
  that bind us...!

"You came back... you truly came back.
  To see your face again,
  there is no greater joy...

"How much your mother longed to see you.
  Through countless lonely, painful nights,
  I waited, believing you would return...

"Mother, I'm sorry to have worried you.
  Now the man-eating firedrake
  will never attack the village again...

"They are the liberators of our fate.
  Travelers who restored the Yata Mirror
  and lifted your curse.

"Thank you, travelers.
  Thanks to you, the firedrake's bond is cut
  and I could see my mother again...

"We shall never forget this debt.
  Come to the shrine in Hotto
  and we'll thank you properly.
